profile.headline: Lead .NET Developer | Software Architecture & Design | Bourbon and Guitar Enthusiast
profile.summary:
Conscientious and detailed software engineer/architect with over 20 years experience in application development with Microsoft technologies.

My current focus has been designing and implementing distributed enterprise solutions with ASP.NET Core Web API and REST services using CQRS, Event-Driven Architecture, Azure Function Apps, Service Bus and MongoDb. 

I place high value on delivering quality code using test-driven development, SOLID principles, design patterns and industry best practices.
